reader_summary.headline: Collette Chilton is the CIO of Williams College where she has overseen its $3 billion since 2006.
reader_summary.overview: Collette Chilton is the CIO of Williams College where she has overseen its $3 billion since 2006. Collette is nothing short of a legend in the business. She has sat in a CIO seat since the early 1990s at the helm of public pension MassPrim and corporate pension Lucent before joining Williams.

key_points.text: Institutional Investors bestowed its Lifetime Achievement Award on Collette in 2019.
Our conversation covers Collette's career path and lessons learned before joining Williams.
We then turn to her arrival at Williams in 2006 to a phone, a computer, and a legacy portfolio.
